cohort: 214,070 pregnant women enrolled in the study from 106 communities at seven sites in Argentina, Guatemala, India, Kenya, Pakistan and Zambia
finding: Most maternal, fetal, and neonatal deaths occurred at or around delivery and were attributed to preventable causes, primarily hemorrhage, pre-eclampsia/eclampsia, or sepsis.
country: Argentina, Guatemala, India, Kenya, Pakistan, and Zambia
